company_context: Younique is a global direct sales company focused on cosmetics, skin care, and wellness products, with operations in 22 countries, hundreds of millions in annual revenue, and tens of thousands of independent sellers.
summary_paragraphs: Led the transformation of Younique’s legacy e-commerce and salesforce tools to a modern, internally developed mobile-first platform. Asked by the founder and CEO to serve as President and oversee all day-to-day operations. Restructured the leadership team and made a key marketing hire. Streamlined product development, revamped the global commission plan, and introduced agile principles across the corporate workforce. Exited unprofitable markets, aligned budgets with key priorities, and streamlined legacy business processes.
